repository.name: HA-Energy-Price-Engine
repository.description: A modular Home Assistant integration that automatically retrieves, calculates and stores complete electricity prices, including spot prices, grid tariffs, supplier fees, taxes and VAT. Provides persistent 15-minute price data for EV charging, heating, battery storage and smart energy automation.

release.name: v0.1.0-beta.5 — simple setup with saved steps
release.body:
Beta.5 replaces ordinary draft/date editing with **five native setup stages that save each accepted page**: site/source → grid → supplier agreement → taxes → numerical review. Close and reopen Configure to resume. Review needs no final save.

**Prerelease for development Home Assistant acceptance testing.** Private contracts, real sources and hardware still require your own checks.

Source: **a4ede923e42573def49026a8d1d817c37a979171**. Immutable tag: **v0.1.0-beta.5**. [Draft PR #14](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/pull/14) remains unmerged. Prior releases and main are preserved.

## Install or update

1. Back up development HA. Add `https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine` to HACS custom repositories as **Integration** if needed.
2. Open Energy Price Engine, persist **Show beta versions**, refresh information, select **v0.1.0-beta.5**, download and restart HA. Device info must show **0.1.0-beta.5**.
3. Existing sites: choose **Configure** on the existing entry. New sites: install/configure the official Home Assistant Nord Pool integration first, then Add integration → Energy Price Engine. A legacy live broker is unnecessary; use recorded data for offline comparisons.
4. Confirm the actual area/grid product. Choose a freshly verified public EWII offer and confirm your actual agreement, or enter your own markup in **øre/kWh**, VAT inclusion and optional monthly fee. Ordinary setup needs no dates. Save and continue applies each page.
5. Review the eight component rates/source/status rows. Click a row to edit; **Check prices** forces verification. Final prices opens Diagnostics; Advanced holds dated overrides, display and site/storage tools. Compare a stored quarter with your bill and restart.

[Illustrated setup and short demos](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/v0.1.0-beta.5/docs/WIZARD_GUIDE.md) · [Exact HACS steps](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/v0.1.0-beta.5/docs/HACS_DISTRIBUTION.md) · [Acceptance checklist](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/v0.1.0-beta.5/docs/BETA_ACCEPTANCE.md) · [Native simulation evidence](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/v0.1.0-beta.5/docs/receipts/v0.1.0-beta.5-simulation.json)

## Changes and pricing safety

- Each accepted source/grid/agreement/tax step is actual persisted HA configuration. Saved confirmations and close/reopen resume replace hidden drafts. Direct review edits return to review and preserve other components. Closing cannot submit fields still being typed; submit the page first.
- Official Nord Pool entry metadata supplies supported area, timezone and input conventions. Multiple supported areas require explicit selection. DK1/DK2 never proves a customer's grid operator/class; Radius C requires confirmation.
- EWII Basis/Plus suggestions use official primary product statements, source URL/time/hash and a maximum 24h fallback. Observed October 27: Basis 16.5øre/0DKK monthly, Plus 6.5øre/29DKK monthly. These are public offers, never permanent private defaults. Official pages do not clearly establish the markup VAT convention, so the user must confirm it from their agreement. Unavailable/stale suggestions are withheld; manual input remains.
- Current confirmed rates start at the **next complete quarter**, open-ended until changed. Existing historical rules and scheduled future date/hour overrides are preserved. Earlier unknown intervals are never filled and settled rows never rewritten. The initial day can have only remaining-day coverage; full-day consumer reads remain INCOMPLETE, while complete active future ranges can be READY.
- Compact English/Danish component checklist shows actual numerical prices including VAT, with direct settings links. Diagnostics retain applied canonical values, periods, sources/status and corrective actions. Raw source readiness stays separate from final readiness. Monthly subscriptions stay outside marginal prices.
- Explicitly approved provisional rates remain separate **ESTIMATED / UNVERIFIED visualization-only** values. They never enter verified SQLite history, publish authoritative revisions or give CM READY prices. Missing rates never become zero. Do not use estimates for charging control.
- Existing beta.1–.4 IDs, names, source references, entities, dated overrides, SQLite rows/revisions and read-only API v1 are preserved. Transactional touched-row SQLite persistence, safe selected-site deletion, native device version/branding and PE-only HACS beta repair remain.
- Mandatory local refreshes remain **13:05, 13:20, 13:40, 23:59, 00:01**. Negative prices, Radius time bands, VAT once, DST and independent sites remain covered. Two-price-chart issue #10 stays out of scope.

## Validation and integrity

- **234 producer tests per core**, HA **2026.10.3 / current 2026.10.4**, zero skips, 88% coverage. Two deprecation warnings originate in unchanged pinned HACS code.
- Four unchanged consumer suites **153/176/227/228 cases per core**, plus two coupled startup/runtime cases per consumer/core. No CM code or controls changed.
- Actual pinned HACS 2.0.5/upstream registration, beta discovery, install/update/uninstall/reinstall and authenticated channel repair/store restore. Official hassfest, translations, HACS metadata and independent native installation of both ZIP layouts outside source on both cores.
- Real disposable HA 2026.10.4/frontend 20260930.5 desktop/mobile EN/DA: first run, each-step saving, interrupted resume, custom/public agreement, missing/provisional correction, explicit refresh, source outage/recovery and restart. Four beta.4 sites preserve configuration and historical decoded rows; nine-site restart preserves settled rows/revisions. Confirmed deletion removes only one 115-row site; same-name recreation has new ID and empty history. 19 screenshots and two short recordings. No final frontend errors; mobile width 390 without overflow.
- Fictional test example: .100 spot + .200 grid + .111 supplier + .043 net + .072 system + .008 tax = .534 DKK ex VAT; ×1.25=**.6675 DKK / 66.75 øre including VAT**. Public Plus example assumes an explicitly confirmed fictional incl-VAT agreement, not inferred public VAT terms.
- Exact source CI must pass before publication. Publisher verifies immutable annotated tag/source, all15 source checks, clean deterministic hashes, and both archive installations before upload. Public release/assets/source/HACS are independently checked afterward on both cores; final receipt is committed to PR #14.

```text
9f8ea839a04b5d67f61dc0e49f11611abcb4c85cdfced809f813937548dc0ad0  ha_energy_price_engine.zip
422c5d1bb39c4596a4af36db2e325ad56b642b8287e2bc09409d96a5928d3036  ha_energy_price_engine-manual.zip
```

BUILD_MANIFEST identifies clean source/runtime payload; `published:false` means the builder itself never publishes. HACS installs the exact selected release tag. For manual placement extract the manual ZIP at HA's configuration root. The smaller root-layout ZIP belongs inside `custom_components/ha_energy_price_engine/`.

## Limits and remaining owner acceptance

Radius automation supports confirmed Radius C. National baselines are bounded verified dated data, not live legislative discovery: Energinet .043/.072 DKK ex VAT during 2026, tax .008 during 2026–2027. Future periods/other products need verified rates; heating eligibility is never guessed. Historical household EWII .030 DKK ex VAT applies June–September 2026 only and is never a current or other-site default.

Unsubmitted typing cannot survive closing a native HA form. Avoid simultaneous editing of one site. Forms follow the user's language; existing shared entities follow system/registry language. HACS's external brands catalog may show a fallback even while PE's native local icon works. Keep Show beta versions enabled; if HACS shows a hash, use its setting or PE's explicitly approved Advanced → Storage / site management → HACS beta channel repair.

One-year concurrent cloud SQLite repeat: 35,136 rows / 18.24 MB, append 96 rows .0457s, reload 2.240s, lookup 10.06µs. **Cloud timings do not establish Raspberry Pi performance.** Immutable history stays in memory for API v1. Your source, bill, heating eligibility, physical mobile experience and hardware recovery/performance remain owner acceptance steps.

No production HA, Node-RED, vehicles, chargers or CM were changed. No main merge or stable release. Development stops after beta.5 publication and independent verification.
